adjudication.evidence: P1 (single point at 535) shows no sustained shift or return; P2 (545–546) is a 2-day interval with large offsets but no clear opposing return in N/E/U—interior observations show continued motion, not platform behavior; P3 (550–612) begins near a large step at 550 (visible in original N/E/U jump from ~9.3 to ~14.6 in N), but the offset does not reverse within the interval—U drops sharply and stays low, no return observed. No candidate satisfies the definition of a temporary offset (sustained shift + opposing return across same axes). Independent permanent step at 550 is evident, but no genuine temporary platform exists.
